summary: B.Tech student (ECE - Data Science & Machine Learning) at MMMUT Gorakhpur with hands-on experience in AI/ML, full-stack web development, and algorithmic trading, spanning internships, a self-founded MSME-registered tech venture, and an active YouTube trading education channel.

bullets.text: Worked on ML & AI-based projects covering data preprocessing, feature engineering, model development, and evaluation
Developed practical solutions using Python, Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn
Applied ML techniques on real-world datasets for prediction, classification, and data-driven analysis
Executed end-to-end ML workflows: data preparation, model training, evaluation, prediction
Gained hands-on experience in AI/ML research, experimentation, and solution development
Developed responsive and user-friendly web application features using React.js, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, ensuring cross-device compatibility and an improved user experience
Integrated REST APIs, identified and resolved application bugs, and optimized performance to enhance functionality and responsiveness
Collaborated with the development team using Git/GitHub in an Agile development environment, contributing to feature implementation, code reviews, and project delivery
Founded and manage an active trading education community on YouTube; design and deploy automated trading strategies for algorithmic execution
Applied backtesting and model evaluation on historical data using Chartink and TradingView; conducted live trading sessions and created educational content on algorithmic and rule-based strategies
